meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给画面加上推拉、缩放与运镜关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在视频合成里做镜头运动或关键帧动画。
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-ins, zooms, and camera-move keyframes to a composition
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need camera moves or keyframe animation inside video compositions.

howto.what: 在 HyperFrames 合成里为画面写可跳转（seek-safe）的关键帧动画:推近拉出、缩放、重构构图、Ken Burns 移动、蒙版、SVG 形变、文字位移、3D 深度等,并用 lint、check、keyframes、snapshot 命令验证。不管剪辑拼接和场景策略。
howto.when: 当 HyperFrames 合成需要推近/拉出、缩放、重构构图等关键帧动画时接管,也适用于 GSAP、CSS keyframes、Anime.js 等运行时的实现与 `hyperframes keyframes` 诊断。不负责场景策略、品牌设计、素材选取、字幕。

say.text: 给这段 HyperFrames 合成加一个从全景推近到主体的关键帧
say.note: 写出可跳转的 scale/translate 关键帧并校验

say.text: 让标题按词依次出现,末帧保持可读、不要淡出
say.note: 逐词关键帧,末帧算动画的一部分

say.text: 用 hyperframes keyframes 检查这段动画的路径和采样帧
say.note: 生成快照并报告关键帧落点

howto.what_en: Adds seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes inside a HyperFrames composition: punch-ins, zooms, reframes, Ken Burns moves, masks, SVG morphs, text motion, and 3D depth, verified with lint, check, keyframes, and snapshot commands.
howto.when_en: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, zoom, reframe, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, and for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Not for scene strategy, brand design, or captions.

say_en.text: Add a keyframe that pushes in from wide to the subject in this composition
say_en.note: Writes seek-safe scale/translate keyframes and verifies them

say_en.text: Have the title appear word by word and hold readable at the end
say_en.note: Adds per-word keyframes; final frame stays readable

say_en.text: Check this animation's path and sample frames with hyperframes keyframes
say_en.note: Generates shots and reports keyframe stops
